title: Console browser-smoke defaults to system Chrome on macOS
description: Evidence: apps/console/src/browser-smoke.ts defaults --chrome to /Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome, while local agent instructions require Playwright-managed Chromium and prior Boreal evidence shows browser smoke passed with Playwright headless shell. Impact: default browser smoke can trigger known macOS Chrome crash dialogs under automation.
acceptanceCriteria: Browser smoke defaults to Playwright-managed Chromium/headless shell or requires an explicit executable, and docs/scripts no longer hard-code system Chrome.
